description: GH #33 batch (eb-branch) — stop macOS re-prompting for Accessibility / Screen Recording / Automation after every Mac rebuild. Full spec: tasks/prd-mac-tcc-cdhash-regrant.md. This queue is the LAYER-1 SECONDARY POLISH ONLY (ralph-safe, pure Swift, compile-gated): US-001 detect own-cdhash change across launches; US-002 remove the unconditional Screen-Recording-pane auto-open (QuipMacApp.swift:589-591) and replace with a gated non-intrusive `permissionsNeedAttention` signal; US-003 menubar 'Fix Permissions…' affordance so the user re-grants on their terms. LAYER-2 ROOT CAUSE is the GH #13 signing overhaul (project.yml DEVELOPMENT_TEAM D2PM6R797Q + real identity + hardened runtime + a macOS provisioning profile) — that is US-004/US-005 in the spec, MANUAL and LAST, EXCLUDED from this autonomous loop because it needs an Apple Developer portal action and will fail the compile-gate without a profile (same restricted-entitlement wall that blocked the keychain future-proof). Native gate = `xcodebuild` QuipMac (-swift-version 6, the only isolation oracle) BUILD SUCCEEDED + noted unit tests compile/pass; this is QuipMac code so it NEEDS a Mac rebuild to land (wipes TCC once — that is the user's manual install/re-grant pass, do NOT block a story on it). Ideally these 3 + the manual US-004 land in ONE rebuild so the user re-grants exactly once. NEVER push eb-branch without an explicit literal 'push'.

userStories.title: Detect cdhash change across launches
userStories.description: As QuipMac, I need to know whether my own code signature changed since the last launch, so I can tell a 'you just rebuilt — re-grant' transition apart from a steady-state launch.
acceptanceCriteria: New helper (e.g. QuipMac/Services/CodeIdentity.swift) reads the running app's own cdhash: SecCodeCopySelf -> SecCodeCopyStaticCode -> SecCodeCopySigningInformation with kSecCodeInfoUnique, rendered to a hex string; returns nil (degrade-safe) if any step fails
Persist the last-seen cdhash in UserDefaults (e.g. key 'lastLaunchCDHash')

Expose didCodeIdentityChangeSinceLastLaunch() -> Bool: true on first run ever (no stored value) OR when current != stored; updates the stored value as a side effect so the next launch reads 'unchanged'
A pure unit test covers the compare/update logic with an INJECTED store + INJECTED cdhash provider (do NOT depend on the live SecCode read in the test)
On a nil cdhash read, err toward 'changed' (signal rather than go silent)

Gate: xcodebuild QuipMac (-swift-version 6) BUILD SUCCEEDED, no new warnings in changed files; NEEDS a Mac rebuild to land — install/TCC re-grant is the user's manual pass, do not block the story on it
userStories.notes: Done 2026-06-20. QuipMac/Services/CodeIdentity.swift: CodeIdentityStore seam (UserDefaults conforms via setString shim) + currentCDHash() (SecCodeCopySelf→StaticCode→SigningInformation[kSecCodeInfoUnique]→hex, nil on any failure) + didCodeIdentityChangeSinceLastLaunch(store:currentHash:) — first-run/changed persists side-effect, unchanged no-rewrite, nil read errs toward changed without clobbering stored. Tests: QuipMac/Tests/CodeIdentityTests.swift (injected FakeStore + injected hash, 6 cases). Gate: xcodebuild macOS BUILD SUCCEEDED + build-for-testing TEST BUILD SUCCEEDED, no new warnings; standalone swiftc logic oracle 14/14. NEEDS Mac rebuild to land (bundle into US-002/003 + manual US-004 for one re-grant pass).

userStories.title: Replace unconditional pane auto-open with a gated non-intrusive signal
userStories.description: As a user, I don't want to be yanked into System Settings on every launch that preflights a permission false; I want a quiet signal only when something actually changed.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the unconditional openSettingsPane(.screenRecording) at QuipMac/QuipMacApp.swift:589-591
On launch: if didCodeIdentityChangeSinceLastLaunch() (US-001) is true AND a permission preflights false, set a published permissionsNeedAttention state — do NOT force-open any pane
If the cdhash is unchanged, never auto-open any pane (steady state stays silent)
The existing 5s permsTimer / wake-probe behaviour is unchanged except a dropped grant flips permissionsNeedAttention instead of opening a pane

Gate: xcodebuild QuipMac (-swift-version 6) BUILD SUCCEEDED; verify NO launch code path calls openSettingsPane without an explicit user action; NEEDS a Mac rebuild to land (user's manual install/re-grant pass)
userStories.notes: Done 2026-06-20. Removed the unconditional openSettingsPane(.screenRecording) launch block (QuipMacApp.swift ~589). Replaced with a gated raise: in the 1.0s initial broadcast, CodeIdentity.didCodeIdentityChangeSinceLastLaunch() (called once/launch for its store side effect) AND permissionsStore.deniedCount > 0 → set permissionsStore.permissionsNeedAttention = true; never opens a pane. New @Observable property MacPermissionsStore.permissionsNeedAttention (Services/MacPermissionsStore.swift) — quiet signal, distinct from anyDenied. broadcastPermissions(force:) now keeps it truthful WITHOUT opening a pane: a dropped grant (deniedCount rises vs lastPermissionsSnapshot) raises it; all-granted (deniedCount==0) clears it; constant denial leaves as-is. First force:true probe has nil lastPermissionsSnapshot so the rise-check is skipped → steady-state launch with an already-missing grant + unchanged cdhash stays silent (AC#3). openSettingsPane now reachable ONLY via user action: phone open_mac_settings_pane handler (QuipMacApp.swift ~1689) + SettingsView Grant button — verified by grep, no launch path. Tests: +2 in Tests/MacPermissionsStoreTests.swift (default false, independent of anyDenied). Gate: xcodebuild macOS BUILD SUCCEEDED + TEST BUILD SUCCEEDED, no new warnings in changed files (pre-existing 'Bundle cloudflared' run-script warning only). NEEDS Mac rebuild to land — bundle with US-003 + manual US-004 for one re-grant pass; do not block on hardware verify.

userStories.title: Menubar 'Fix Permissions…' affordance
userStories.description: As a user, I want a persistent, non-intrusive way to fix dropped grants on my own terms — a menubar warning glyph plus a one-click 'fix' that opens the right pane.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing menubar warning glyph (referenced at QuipMacApp.swift:560 comment) lights when permissionsNeedAttention OR any probed permission is false

The menubar menu gains a 'Fix Permissions…' item; clicking it opens the System Settings pane(s) for whichever permission(s) are currently missing (Screen Recording / Accessibility / Automation), reusing openSettingsPane + the current permissionProbe snapshot
Opening a pane is now reachable ONLY via this user action (or the existing phone red-X-row tap), never automatically on launch
Gate: xcodebuild QuipMac (-swift-version 6) BUILD SUCCEEDED, no new warnings in changed files; NEEDS a Mac rebuild to land (user's manual install/re-grant pass)
userStories.notes: Done 2026-06-20. (1) Menubar glyph (QuipMacApp.swift ~191) now lights on `permissionsStore.anyDenied || permissionsStore.permissionsNeedAttention` (was anyDenied only) — so the quiet US-002 attention signal, not just a live probe-false, raises the warning triangle. (2) New 'Fix Permissions…' item in MenuBarView.actionsSection (QuipMac/Views/MenuBarView.swift), shown only when `permissionsNeedAttention || anyDenied` (steady state stays clean); fixPermissions() opens the System Settings pane(s) for every currently-missing perm via the live probe snapshot + reuses openPane (same `MacSettingsPane.systemSettingsURL` → NSWorkspace.open as the per-row buttons / phone red-❌ taps / SettingsView Grant), then clears permissionsNeedAttention as the user's acknowledgment (a still-denied perm keeps the glyph lit via anyDenied; broadcastPermissions clears all on re-grant). (3) Pane-open is user-action-only: grepped every call site — phone open_mac_settings_pane handler (~1709), SettingsView Grant (~534), MenuBarView permissionRow + new Fix Permissions, and the failed-arrange Accessibility nudge (~2031) — none on a launch path; the US-002 launch gate only sets permissionsNeedAttention. New pure `MacPermissionsMessage.deniedPanes: [MacSettingsPane]` (Shared/MessageProtocol.swift, mirrors deniedCount; Accessibility→Automation→ScreenRecording order; appleEvents→.automation) is the testable mapping the menu consumes. Tests: +5 in Tests/MacPermissionsStoreTests.swift (empty/all-three-ordered/per-perm map/pair-order/count-parity over all 8 combos). Gate: xcodebuild QuipMac (platform=macOS) ** BUILD SUCCEEDED ** + build-for-testing ** TEST BUILD SUCCEEDED **, no new warnings in changed files (only pre-existing appintents/cloudflared notes); standalone swiftc deniedPanes oracle 14/14 PASS. NO new files → no xcodegen regen. NEEDS a Mac rebuild to land — bundle with US-001/002 (+ manual US-004) so the user re-grants exactly once; install + on-device verify is the user's manual pass, not blocked here.
